diet.title: Diet
diet.tip1: Get protein in every meal: egg, chicken, fish, dal or doi.
diet.tip2: Fill half your plate with vegetables, a bit less rice.
diet.tip3: Cut sugar, soft drinks and fried snacks as much as you can.
diet.tip4: Weigh yourself once a week, in the morning, before eating.
diet.how: Calculated with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula from your profile.
